name: Husqvarna DXR 715 demolition robot
summary: Remote-controlled demolition robot under five tonnes, new in September 2026 as the largest DXR class. It has an extended boom arm for long reach.

germany.statusNote: Husqvarna announced the robot in September 2026 and says it may be bought or leased; no price is published. Husqvarna Deutschland sells the DXR range by quote (the German model page for this robot was not online on 18 Nov 2026).

sellers.note: German sales office (Niederstotzingen); DXR 715 is the extended-boom model.
